title: 第5章 连续三次圣杯第6章 第一笔收益
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
啪嗒、啪嗒
接连两声清脆的落地声，王成宇也将手机镜头对准了地面的杯筊。
直播画面中可以清晰的看到，杯筊一平一凹，呈现一阴一阳之势。
此时，一旁站着的始终是一个表情的道长，看到这一结果，都不禁惊讶道：
“竟是圣杯！”
王成宇看着道长终于有了表情，立刻将镜头移了过去，并且好奇的问道：
“道长，圣杯是什么意思啊？”
道长没有避讳镜头，不过此时的他已经恢复了平静。
“一平一凹，代表的是圣杯。”
“而圣杯则代表着，神明同意了询问者的请求。”
闻言，王成宇惊喜道：
“那岂不是说，雷祖同意林楠扮演他了？！”
然而，道长却摇了摇头解释道：
“现在还不行，不论什么事情问神都要问三次，这才只是第一次而已。”
“而且如果是要扮演神明，要求则更加的严格，需要掷杯的三次结果都是圣杯才可以，哪怕有一次笑杯或者阴杯都不行。”
王成宇这才收起了惊喜的神色，眉宇间也有了些紧张。
“要三次一样啊，那确实有点难度。”
此时的网友们看到这一结果，也刷新了不少的评论。
【没想到竟然真的出圣杯了！
【看来主播不仅长得像雷祖，还真的得了雷祖他老人家的青眼，第一次掷杯的结果就不错。

【举镜头的是哪位？看来对掷杯一点都不了解啊。
连续三次圣杯，何止是有点难度，那可以说是非常难了！
在我们福省，扮神的人每年都有很多，但是最后能够扮演的却很少。
那是因为，只有神明同意的人，才能在游神的时候进行扮演，而得不到神明同意的人有大把的呢。
【劝主播别高兴的太早了，三次都是圣杯，那真的是天意才能掷出的，但凡有一点侥幸心理都不行。
【主播快掷第二次啊，我们等着出结果呢！
掷圣杯，就像是刮彩票。
没出结果的时候，所有人的心里都是痒痒的。
看了评论，林楠也不墨迹，将地上的杯筊拿起，很快便掷出了第二次。
这一次，道长不再像之前一样事不关己，反而一直盯着林楠手中的杯筊，想要知道这次的结果。
啪嗒、啪嗒
又是两声脆响。
道长的双眼，也随之瞪大！
王成宇惊喜的声音再度响起。
“卧槽，又是圣杯！
楠哥你真的太厉害了！”
content_en:
snap, snap
With two crisp landing sounds in succession, Wang Chengyu also pointed the camera of his mobile phone at the cup on the ground.
It can be clearly seen in the live broadcast that the cup is flat and concave, showing a yin and yang trend.
At this time, the Taoist priest who always had an expression standing on the side couldn't help but be surprised when he saw this result:
"It's the Holy Grail!"
Wang Chengyu saw that the Taoist priest finally had an expression, immediately moved the camera over, and asked curiously:
"Taoist Priest, what does the Holy Grail mean?"
The Taoist priest did not shy away from the camera, but at this time he had regained his composure.
"One flat and one concave represents the Holy Grail."
"The Holy Grail represents that the gods agreed to the inquirer's request."
Hearing this, Wang Chengyu said in surprise:
"Doesn't that mean that Lei Zu agreed to Lin Nan playing him?!"
However, the Taoist priest shook his head and explained:
"It's not possible now. No matter what you ask God about, you have to ask it three times. This is only the first time."
"And if you want to play the role of a god, the requirements are even stricter. You need to throw the cup three times and the result is the Holy Grail, even if there is a Laughing Cup or a Yin Cup."
Wang Chengyu then put away his surprised expression, and his eyebrows became a little nervous.
"It's really difficult to do the same thing three times."
At this time, netizens saw this result and refreshed many comments.
[I didn’t expect that the Holy Grail would actually appear!
[It seems that the host not only looks like Lei Zu, but he also really has the favor of Lei Zu, and the result of the first cup throw is good.
[Who is holding up the lens? It seems that he doesn’t know anything about cup throwing.
Obtaining the Holy Grail three times in a row is not only a little difficult, it can be said to be very difficult!
In our province, there are many people pretending to be gods every year, but in the end there are very few who can play the role.
That's because only people with the consent of the gods can perform while wandering the gods, and there are many people who don't get the consent of the gods.
[I advise the host not to be happy too early. The Holy Grail is the Holy Grail three times. It is really only God’s will that throws it. It doesn’t work if there is any chance.
[Anchor, please throw the second time, we are waiting for the result!
Tossing the Holy Grail is like scratching a lottery ticket.
When there was no result, everyone felt itchy in their hearts.
After reading the comments, Lin Nan picked up the cup on the ground and quickly threw it out for the second time.
This time, the Taoist Master no longer had nothing to do with himself as before. Instead, he kept staring at the cup in Lin Nan's hand, wanting to know the outcome of this time.
snap, snap
There were two more crisp sounds.
The Taoist Priest's eyes also widened!
Wang Chengyu's voice of surprise sounded again.
“Damn it, it’s the Holy Grail again!
Brother Nan, you are really amazing! "
